# MM-P1-L4-HT03 - Maintenance manual - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HT03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-002, SB-1006, SOP-P1-L4-02

Scope
This document defines required maintenance actions for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03). It covers preventive maintenance tasks, required tools, detailed procedure for routine checks, and acceptance criteria to confirm safe and repeatable operation. Refer to ECN-2026-002, SB-1006, and SOP-P1-L4-02 for design changes and operating procedures.

Tools
- Portable calibrated thermometer (as required by SOP-P1-L4-02)  
- Hand tools and insulated gloves per site PPE requirements (see SB-1006)  
- Calibration standard and documentation forms referenced in ECN-2026-002

Procedure
- Verify work area is safe and furnace is in standby following SOP-P1-L4-02.  
- Inspect chamber lining, door seals, and visible heating elements for integrity; address any damage per ECN-2026-002.  
- Verify control system connectivity and examine indicators for error codes; escalate per SB-1006 if present.  
- The austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is 880 °C. Confirm setpoint matches control display.  
- Perform thermocouple check and document offset per calibration standard. The thermocouple calibration interval for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is 95 days. Schedule next calibration in accordance with that interval and record in maintenance log.  
- Perform functional run to confirm stable ramp and soak behavior as described in SOP-P1-L4-02. Record observations and any deviations.

Acceptance criteria
- Control setpoint matches documented value: The austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is 880 °C.  
- Thermocouple calibration current and recorded next calibration meet site schedule: The thermocouple calibration interval for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is 95 days.  
- No active alarms or unresolved errors per SB-1006.  
- Maintenance actions and calibration records filed as required by ECN-2026-002 and SOP-P1-L4-02.
